scope.description: What the question is about: one thread, one process (program) as a whole, or the whole trace.

symptom.description: The problem the question describes, or none for a describe/overview question.

target.description: The thread (tid) or process (pid, tid null) the question is clearly about; both null when it is not clear and the suspects must be searched.

suspects.description: At most 5 candidates, most likely first: threads (tid) for scope thread, processes (pid, tid null) for scope process. Empty when the target is clear or the scope is trace.

question_numbers.description: Numbers the question states, converted to milliseconds; null when not stated.

magnitude_ms.description: A stated size of the problem: 'delayed by about 30 ms', 'took about 15 ms'.

range_start_ms.description: Start of a stated time range, in ms from the trace start.

range_end_ms.description: End of a stated time range, in ms from the trace start.

follow_up.description: True when the question continues the previous question's target.

reasoning.description: One to three sentences: why this scope, symptom and target or suspects.
